scope: Unilever Tier A only. '@A' means fitted on the Tier A cohort; only @A variants are eligible.
framing: The challengers TIE with MA3 (DEC-25, DEC-26). Nothing here beats MA3.

insufficient.note: None. The provisional trailing average is itself the fallback, so it has nothing to fall back to.

short.note: One listed alternative, not a ranked chain.

medium.note: Ordered: MA3 first, then comb_simple, then MA12.

long.watch_note: Re-test when a third block is testable. The long bin cannot reach FIT with only 2 testable blocks.

excluded: @ABC variants - models are Tier A only.
ADIDA = IMAPA = SES-equivalent on this cohort, so they add nothing distinct.
OTM - hand-coded and unvalidated, not eligible.
chronos_bolt - not run; the environment blocks torch.
